title: NNTP OVER: invalid range input → 501 not Range(0,0)
description: 5w3.23: in dispatch.rs or lifecycle.rs, OVER/XOVER with non-numeric or reversed range silently becomes Range(0,0). Must return 501 Syntax error per RFC 3977. Fix: parse OVER argument; if missing digits or lo>hi, return 501 immediately.
